chung.Syllabus Name: Creative Writing_Sản xuất nội dung sáng tạo
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 55 hours online + 3 hrs offline + 1,5hr exam + 90.5h self-study
chung.Description: This specialization explores three key genres of creative writing: short story, narrative essay, and memoir. You will learn the techniques used by skilled writers to craft compelling stories with memorable characters, engaging settings, and fresh descriptive styles. You will also analyze and provide constructive feedback on peer writing. In the Capstone project, you will draft, revise, and complete an original story in the genre of your choice. Through four courses, each focusing on a specific aspect of writing and taken in any order, you will enhance your writing skills, refine your ability to critique others' work, and draw inspiration from the literature you already enjoy reading.

danhGia:
For the final exam, students answer two questions: one theoretical question and one practical question.

For the practical question, students are asked to apply all skills they have learned in the course to create a story of minimum 400 words, either fiction or nonfiction. The topic of the story is given by the exam board. The exam topics will revolve around the areas previously covered.

The story should involve a plot, character, setting and description and show their style. The writing must include the following elements:

1. A clear plot structure: with beginning, development, climax, and resolution.

2. Well-developed, consistent, and memorable characters.

3. A vividly described setting in terms of time and space, rich in sensory detail.

4. Use of creative language that reflects a personal and distinctive writing style.
Not allow to use any document/information in any form in exam room
